text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert: sa-east-1 (azf) NLB keepalive throttle -> increased Envoy connection resets and 5xx spike
miguel: seeing it, paging oncall. I'm taking initial ack. Starting triage.
sylvie: I'm online, joining now. what’s the impact? any customer-visible errors?
miguel: dashboards show 5xx rate at 18% for edge-ingress in sa-east-1 azf, latency up 300ms. error type: envoy upstream reset / ECONNRESET.
amelia-support: multiple support tickets from APAC customers seeing partial outages. tickets referenced 'request failed with 502'.
raj: logs show NLB TCP connections hitting keepalive limit per target group; SYN/FIN churn on targets. Envoy upstream flushes on idle.
dave-eng-platform: can you paste the NLB target metrics and connection count?
miguel: pasting snippet:
```
NLB_TargetConnections: 98k
NLB_ActiveConnectionsPerTarget: 12k
TargetHealth: flapping for instance ids i-0a.../i-0b...
```
raj: looks like per-target conn limit throttle in azf. NLB has been GC'ing connections; backend envoys are overwhelmed by connection resets.
sylvie: quick mitigation idea: drain targets in azf and shift weighted Route53 traffic to sa-east-1-aga (secondary region) while we stabilize. lower TTL first.
miguel: agreed. steps:
1) set Route53 weighted policy: azf weight -> 0, aga -> 100
2) lower ALB/NLB deregistration delay? deregister targets in azf
3) scale up ingress replicas in other AZs

doing step 1 now (lower TTL to 30s) :gear:
miguel: route53 change submitted, TTL lowered to 30s. waiting for propagation.
dave-eng-platform: starting target drain in azf, deregistering 2/3 of ingress nodes to stop new connections.
raj: scaling ingress controllers in other AZs + bumping envoy keepalive timeout config (from 75s to 120s) to reduce churn.
amelia-support: notifying impacted customers with temporary guidance: retry/backoff, region fallback where possible. creating status update.
oncall-rotation-bot: Miguel -> Sylvie handoff in 10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sylvie: taking over now. miguel handoff notes: route53 weight changed, 60% of traffic moved, target drain in progress, scaling underway.
sylvie: monitoring logs: 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 6% over 5 minutes. latency trending down.
raj: after drains, we see connection resets reduced. NLB active connections down to 28k.
amelia-support: pushing status update to customers: "Partial degraded service in sa-east-1 being mitigated, traffic shifted."
dave-eng-platform: to fully mitigate, recommend we replace affected ingress instances (AMI rollout) and revisit NLB idle timeout config; open a follow-up rollout ticket.
sylvie: can we mark P1 still active? I'd like to keep page open until <5% errors sustained for 15m.
miguel: agree. I’ll stay on standby for 15m.
(oncall-rotation-bot: handoff complete)
sylvie: 5xx rate at 2.1% sustained 16m. marking as mitigated. initiating post-incident follow-up:
- RCA: NLB per-target connection pressure in sa-east-1 azf + Envoy keepalive mismatch -> connection resets.
- Immediate mitigations: Route53 weighted shift, target drain, ingress scaling, Envoy keepalive increase.
- Actions: change NLB idle timeout, add connection limits alerts, rollout AMI replacements for flapping targets, run chaos/soak tests for sa-east region NLB behavior.
amelia-support: updating status page: "incident mitigated, full recovery in progress" :white_check_mark:
raj: leaving a note: we'll run a config audit for keepalive/idle-timeouts across regions.
sylvie: assigning postmortem to eng-sre and eng-platform, will schedule blameless RCA. Thanks team for quick turnout.
miguel: thanks all. closing thread in 30m if no regression.
